record: AISEF V2 — P0 WHEEL EXCLUSION PROOF
owner_requirement: Prove current HEAD wheel excludes aisef2. Prove clean wheel install cannot import aisef2. Prove wheel rebuilt from current sdist also cannot import aisef2.
source_tree: git archive of the source commit (no untracked or ignored files, no stale build/ or *.egg-info)

tooling.offline: PIP_NO_INDEX=1, setuptools taken from the local pip cache; nothing was downloaded
tooling.import_probe: venv python -I (isolated: no cwd, PYTHONPATH or user site on sys.path), cwd outside the repository

comparison_with_frozen_candidate_wheel.archive_sha256_differs_because: zip entry date_time only (124/124 entries); CRC, size, compression and attributes identical in every entry

negative_control.change: the same source with only the line `exclude = ["aisef2*"]` removed from pyproject.toml
negative_control.meaning: the proof can say NO: absence of aisef2 above is caused by the exclude, not by the probe being blind

recurring_check: .github/workflows/tests.yml wheel job: the CI wheel (built by `python -m build`, i.e. rebuilt from the sdist) must contain no aisef2 member and its clean install must not find aisef2
verdict: PROVEN — HEAD wheel and the wheel rebuilt from the sdist exclude aisef2; neither clean install can import it
